text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prior to entering the race, Ines Fujin 
looked as if she couldn't wait for it to 
begin. Her excitement came through even 
more intensely than before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on the grand stage, she's sure to 
show the continuation of the dream they've 
chased together hand-in-hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing in her path are Mejiro Ryan and 
Oguri Cap, both burning with fighting 
spirit to live up to the expectations of 
their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without hesitation, Ines Fujin boldly 
proclaims, "I'm going to enjoy the race 
more than anyone!" The dream-filled Arima 
Kinen is about to begin!
